label: Phase 1 · Project foundation
detail: Create the Next.js App Router project, TypeScript configuration, test setup, responsive page shell, and core design tokens.

label: Phase 2 · Deterministic engine
detail: Define serializable game state and implement the fixed-step loop, paddle movement, serves, scoring, match completion, and deterministic fixtures.

label: Phase 3 · Collision system
detail: Implement wall and paddle collision response, penetration correction, bounded rebound angles, velocity caps, and edge-case unit tests.

label: Phase 4 · Playable responsive interface
detail: Add Canvas rendering, coordinate scaling, resize handling, semantic score HUD, keyboard/touch controls, pause/restart, and both local game modes.

label: Phase 5 · CPU, game feel, and accessibility
detail: Add CPU profiles, speed and rebound tuning, sound controls, reduced motion, high-contrast cues, focus management, status announcements, and mobile resilience.

label: Phase 6 · Verification and release candidate
detail: Pass engine, component, browser, performance, responsive, accessibility, and real-device gates, then produce the static export candidate.
